# Architecture Options and ADRs

1. Pre-register hard gates, scoring weights, evidence penalties, risk ceiling, and workloads.
2. Apply commercial-use, security, privacy, accessibility, export, and content-rights gates first.
3. Compare finalists using the same numeric workloads and monthly, one-year, and three-year TCO.
4. Distinguish official research, disposable mechanism spikes, and future implementation tests.
5. Mark blocked evidence honestly; never imply production proof.
6. Write ADRs with context, options, decision, consequences, reversibility, portability/exit, data export, cost, confidence, and reconsideration trigger.
7. Require exact artifact/SHA-bound approvals before the decision becomes accepted.
